facts.fact: Neela recalls Rema ordering Chathu south to Kodiyur in a closed cart with her roll for the high court (F752). From Usha's remark that a Kettamala cell's post ends in the queen's household (F745), she infers he is now in the queen's cells under the palace rock, and admits she cannot be sure.
Corrects F754: the resin was split by hands as 36 pinches for the gorge and 6 for the road, 42 odiyans in all; Devan takes none.
Meenu was once held in a cage the width of a hunter's arm.
Ammu told Neela the page rule (a page held by its own subject cannot be read against her by anyone else) in the straw of the kennel.
Devan has grey in his hair.
After her page was read, Kamalakshi stood in the sun a long time and then ate two bowls of rice; her first laugh is still at the shelter (F717).
